{{Quote|The ''Techno Union'' are ''wealthy'', Snips. They're so used to having ''servants'' around&mdash;even if they're usually droids&mdash;that they won't ''pay attention'' to you. Which means ''no one'' will ''notice'' when you leave to explore the base and find those advanced ''battle droid plans'' we need.|[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], to [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]]|<ref name="Suited" />}}
[[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] partook in an '''undercover mission''' to steal valuable data plans for [[IG-88 assassin droid/Legends|advanced battle droids]] from the [[Techno Union/Legends|Techno Union]].
